name: text-speed-width-slant
title: Width/Slant Velocity
description: Khi khung chữ trượt nhanh, chữ giãn rộng và nghiêng về trước; khi dừng, chữ bật về hình gốc như lò xo.

moworks.author: takayu

options.stiffness: of the spring that smooths the speed (200)
options.slant: slnt at full speed (−12, clamped to the font's −10)

credit.author: TakayuStudio (motion-reference)
credit.licence: No licence stated: idea and numbers only
credit.madeNote: written here from the idea and its numbers; none of the source's code

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-width-slant-scroll, written here): v = speed of a scroll / pan move normalised to 0..1 (demo: 216 px over 0.3–1.8 s, ease (.3,0,.7,1); GSAP |velocity| / 2000), smoothed by a spring (demo k 200, c 16 ≈ 11 % overshoot; GSAP quickTo 0.8 s power3); wdth = 75 + 50v (condensed 75 at rest, 125 at full speed), slnt = −12v (RFlex clamps at −10), pivot on the baseline; when the move stops v springs back to 0. Loop 3.2 s. Params: wdth: hẹp khi nghỉ → rộng khi nhanh (75 → 125) · slnt (0 → −12) · spring: độ cứng / giảm chấn (200 / 16) · move: chuyển động dẫn. The speed is normalised to 0–1 and smoothed by a spring stepped on the film clock, so the letters widen and lean while the text moves fast and spring back when it stops.
moworks.titleVi: Chữ giãn và nghiêng theo tốc độ
